load_word_count_metric: load the word_count evaluation module from the Hugging Face evaluate library
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the word_count evaluation module
compute_word_count: compute word count statistics for a list of text strings using the loaded module
list_evaluation_modules: list all available evaluation modules in the Hugging Face evaluate library
combine_evaluation_modules: combine multiple evaluation modules into a single module for batch metric computation
